name: Trendline breakout and retest
idea: After a close beyond a trendline (the trendline breakout's own settings), wait for the market to come back to that line, read along its slope, and hold it; the idea has ended when the close is back across the line.

params.label: Line touches
params.help: How many swings must touch the line.

params.label: Break distance
params.help: How far beyond the line the breakout close must be, in average true ranges (0 means any close beyond).

params.label: Retest within (bars)
params.help: The return to the broken line must come within this many bars after the breakout; a later return is a new base, not a retest.

params.label: Wait for a reversal at the line
params.help: On: the retest must show a reversal at the broken line. Off: a touch of the line with the close held beyond it is enough.

params.label: The idea is wrong beyond
params.help: Where the retest idea is wrong: beyond the pullback to the line, beyond the breakout's own reference, or beyond whichever of the two is farther.
choice_labels: Whichever of the two is farther

params.label: The breakout's own reference
params.help: As in the trendline breakout: just beyond the broken line, or the far end of the move along the line.
choice_labels: The far end of the move along the line

params.label: Edge buffer
params.help: For 'just beyond the broken line': how many average true ranges beyond it.

lower_of_both.long: Least(RetestEntryRef("retest_low", "up", "trendline_projected", $retest_max_bars, $retest_reversal, k=$k, touches=$touches), RetestEntryRef($breakout_ref, "up", "trendline_projected", $retest_max_bars, $retest_reversal, $stop_mult, k=$k, touches=$touches))
lower_of_both.short: Greatest(RetestEntryRef("retest_low", "down", "trendline_projected", $retest_max_bars, $retest_reversal, k=$k, touches=$touches), RetestEntryRef($breakout_ref, "down", "trendline_projected", $retest_max_bars, $retest_reversal, $stop_mult, k=$k, touches=$touches))
